title: Identity
line: We draw your name, choose your colour and type, and write the rules so anyone on your team can use them.
intro: We draw your name. We show you routes, you choose one, and we refine it until it holds at the size of a browser tab and at the size of a sign. Then we write the rules, so anyone on your team can use it.
